status: proposed engineering contract; not yet validated or enabled
derivative_convention: ContractSigma; other scalar model parameters held fixed
clock: Calendar365 scalar model year fraction; other clock mappings require separate validation
signs: all plus/minus combinations; calendar roll is forward only

reference_policy.step_choice: first eligible adjacent three-step window from coarse to fine; never smallest step or minimum candidate error alone
reference_policy.reference_center: midrange of all admitted estimates in both profiles and three step levels
reference_policy.uncertainty: empirical envelope of adjacent-step drift, profile drift and cancellation indicator; not a rigorous bound

reference_sign_rule: preserve sign when the stabilized reference interval excludes zero and its shock contribution exceeds the reference uncertainty reserve
unavailable_field_outcome: explicitly refused or unresolved; never zero and never removed from request denominator
full_bundle_gate: all eight named cold fields must pass both shock sets and the absolute-component sum; any additionally requested absent axis prevents a full-request pass
full_repricing_taylor_residual: report separately; nonlinearity is not automatically derivative error
